segments.sn44.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca sāriputto, āyasmā ca mahākoṭṭhiko bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye…pe…
segments.sn44.5:1.3: “ko nu kho, āvuso, hetu ko paccayo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti?
segments.sn44.5:1.4: “Rūpe kho, āvuso, avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa ‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’tipissa hoti…pe…
segments.sn44.5:1.5: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
segments.sn44.5:1.9: viññāṇe avigatarāgassa avigatacchandassa avigatapemassa avigatapipāsassa avigatapariḷāhassa avigatataṇhassa ‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’tipissa hoti…pe…
segments.sn44.5:1.10: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’tipissa hoti.
segments.sn44.5:1.15: viññāṇe vigatarāgassa vigatacchandassa vigatapemassa vigatapipāsassa vigatapariḷāhassa vigatataṇhassa ‘hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti…pe…
segments.sn44.5:1.16: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’tipissa na hoti.
segments.sn44.5:1.17: Ayaṃ kho, āvuso, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatā”ti.

lines: Ettha rūpato añño koci satto nāma na upalabbhati, rūpe pana sati nāmamattaṃ etaṃ hotīti dasseti.
Ayaṃ kho āvuso hetūti ayaṃ rūpādīni muñcitvā anupalabbhiyasabhāvo hetu, yenetaṃ abyākataṃ bhagavatāti.
Yo bāhiraparikappito idha tathāgatoti vuccamāno attā.
